objective: rho/G/T satisfy their construction invariants on synthetic input; N_DIRAC-S/N_CNN/N_ViT within the locked 5% tolerance

rho_entropy_cross_validated.note: efficient KxK path vs. brute-force dense eigendecomposition, atol=1e-3

pure_state_entropy_is_zero.note: confirms Construction A's rejection reason (formalization Section 3)

lattice_alone_connected.note: isolates lattice connectivity from the learned top-k head

decision_rule: PASS iff all twelve checks pass (formalization Section 12, falsification gates 1 and 3-6)
interpretation: All five Gate-0 invariants hold on synthetic input: rho is numerically PSD and trace-1 (cross-validated via two independent computational paths — the efficient KxK Gram-matrix entropy shortcut and a brute-force dense eigendecomposition — rather than trusting either alone); the rejected pure-state construction (Construction A) was independently confirmed to have exactly zero entropy, the documented reason it was not used as the default; G has zero orphan nodes and is a single connected component, with lattice connectivity alone (independent of the learned top-k head) verified sufficient; T's gudhi-computed persistence summary is finite; and N_DIRAC-S/N_CNN/N_ViT land within the locked 5% tolerance (CNN 0.41% off, ViT 4.21% off) using the Section 9 complex-parameter-counting convention, which was itself guarded by an explicit no-complex-dtype-parameter assertion. One real design gap was found and fixed during this phase, not merely worked around: ComplexEncoder's transformer initially had no positional encoding at all, discarding spatial information a spatial/relational/topological model should not discard; fixed with a fixed (non-learned, zero added parameters) 3D sinusoidal encoding, which also removed a latent bug where ViT3DBaseline's original learned positional embedding made its parameter count depend on volume_size, which would have silently invalidated this calibration the moment Phase 1 moves from Gate 0's synthetic 64^3 input to the real 128^3 target.
